gaps: RECOVERY_HELPER_TRANSIENT_PROCESS_ZERO_EXIT_GAP
When exactly one broad-pattern canonical process exists but no persistent daemon exists, helper reports a transient/legacy process and exits 0.
A non-daemon process must be blocked/non-zero unless a fresh exact daemon heartbeat and claim are proven.
RECOVERY_HELPER_POSTSTART_TOTAL_PROCESS_CARDINALITY_GAP
After launch the helper blocks only when daemon count exceeds one; one daemon plus extra transient canonical processes can still reach success.
Require exactly one total canonical process and exactly one daemon after start.
RECOVERY_HELPER_DAEMON_INVOCATION_NONCE_STARTTIME_GAP
Wait-ForDaemon accepts any matching daemon without binding PID, parent, creation time or invocation nonce to the current start attempt.
Bind daemon PID, parent PID, executable, arguments, start time and fresh invocation nonce.
RECOVERY_HELPER_LAUNCHER_REPO_ENTRY_BLOB_PIN_GAP
The helper executes the portable launcher or repo devam entry after existence checks only; neither content is hashed and pinned.
Pin and record launcher and repo-entry identity before execution.
RECOVERY_HELPER_EXECUTABLE_IDENTITY_GAP
The helper invokes cmd.exe and powershell.exe by name without recording resolved executable path, version or binary identity.
Resolve an approved executable path and record version/hash before launch.
RECOVERY_HELPER_ROOT_VOLUME_REPARSE_BINDING_GAP
Fixed F paths are checked for existence but not canonical volume identity, reparse points, junctions or resolved containment.
Bind volume serial/root identity and reject unexpected reparse traversal.
RECOVERY_HELPER_RECEIPT_ATOMIC_STRICT_DURABILITY_GAP
Restart receipt uses ConvertTo-Json piped directly to Set-Content at the reusable final path.
Use strict validated JSON, unique temporary file, durability flush and atomic replacement.
RECOVERY_HELPER_RECEIPT_CONTINUATION_GENERATION_GAP
Restart receipt carries task and attempt but no continuation_key, run_id/generation or invocation nonce.
Require exact continuation and current invocation identity in the receipt.
RECOVERY_HELPER_OUTPUT_PATH_CONTAINMENT_GAP
Receipt output is formed by joining a fixed repo root and relative path without resolved containment or reparse validation.
Resolve and verify output remains inside the authorized slot output root.
RECOVERY_OPERATOR_STASH_NEW_OBJECT_BINDING_GAP
After stash push the operator only verifies that refs/stash exists; a pre-existing or concurrently moved stash reference can satisfy the check.
Capture refs/stash before and after and require a newly created object bound to the current stash message.
RECOVERY_OPERATOR_STASH_CONTENT_DIGEST_GAP
The receipt records stash_ref but does not prove the stash tree contains all previously observed dirty and untracked paths.
Record stash commit/tree hashes and verify coverage against the pre-stash snapshot.
RECOVERY_OPERATOR_SNAPSHOT_CRASH_WINDOW_GAP
The pre-recovery snapshot is held only in memory and is published on receipt exit; termination before receipt loses the required snapshot.
Persist an atomic preflight snapshot before any stash/fetch mutation, then append post-sync state.
RECOVERY_OPERATOR_GIT_EXECUTABLE_IDENTITY_GAP
The operator resolves git.exe/git from PATH but does not pin executable path, version or binary identity.
Pin and record the approved Git executable before repository mutation.
RECOVERY_OPERATOR_GIT_DESCENDANT_TIMEOUT_CLEANUP_GAP
Git timeout stops only the direct process ID; credential helpers, SSH and other descendants are not proven terminated.
Use a job object/process-tree kill and receipt proving descendant cleanup.
RECOVERY_OPERATOR_HELPER_DESCENDANT_TIMEOUT_CLEANUP_GAP
Helper timeout stops only the PowerShell helper PID; launcher, cmd, daemon or child PowerShell processes may survive.
Terminate and verify the complete helper process tree while preserving any pre-existing approved daemon.
RECOVERY_OPERATOR_HELPER_HASH_EXECUTION_TOCTOU_GAP
The helper blob is hashed, then executed later by path without an immutable handle or second hash at process start.
Execute an immutable staged copy or revalidate identity immediately before and after launch.
RECOVERY_OPERATOR_RECEIPT_NONCE_FRESHNESS_REPLAY_GAP
Operator and snapshot receipts use reusable latest paths and have no invocation nonce or previous-file quarantine.
Require run_id/nonce, monotonic timestamps and current-attempt freshness before acceptance.
RECOVERY_OPERATOR_RECEIPT_ATOMIC_STRICT_DURABILITY_GAP
Write-JsonFile publishes directly with Set-Content and default PowerShell JSON behavior.
Use atomic strict JSON publication with validated schema and durable replacement.
RECOVERY_OPERATOR_PREFLIGHT_RESOURCE_OBSERVATION_GAP
Recovery performs Git mutation without recording disk space, memory pressure, filesystem status or F-volume availability beyond root existence.
Record bounded preflight resource observations required by the recovery contract.
RECOVERY_OPERATOR_GIT_LOCK_ACTIVE_OPERATION_GAP
Recovery does not inspect active Git processes or age/ownership of index, shallow and sparse-checkout locks before stash/fetch/merge.
Detect active Git operations and only remove proven stale empty locks under the contract.
QUEUE_BROAD_DIRECTORY_WRITE_SCOPE_GAP
Queue allowed_paths authorizes whole runner_outputs and slot web directories instead of an exact machine-enforced write-file set.
Replace broad directory permission with explicit exact_write_paths and reject every other write.
RESTART_REQUEST_RECOVERY_VERIFIER_PIN_GAP
Restart request pins helper and operator scripts but not the operator-recovery verifier executable/blob that decides acceptance.
Pin the exact recovery verifier path/blob and align queue, task, status, checkpoint and request.
